run_evaluate: run the evaluator to compare an evolved eigenvectors solution against the AlgoTune baseline and measure speedup
run_evaluate_stage1: run the stage 1 cascade evaluation to check basic functionality of an evolved eigenvectors solver
run_evaluate_stage2: run the stage 2 cascade evaluation for thorough testing of an evolved eigenvectors solver
run_run_with_timeout: run a function with a configurable timeout using a thread pool executor to prevent hangs
run_calculate_speedup: calculate the speedup ratio between a baseline and evolved solution execution time
